sources.entry: Ghostfolio - Wealth management software to keep track of stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs
Ghostfolio | Wealth management software to track stocks, ETFs and crypto

summary.one_liner: Ghostfolio is an open source, self-hostable wealth management web app for tracking stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies across multiple accounts and platforms.
summary.what_it_does: Ghostfolio lets you record buy, sell, dividend, fee, interest and liability transactions across multiple accounts and track portfolio performance using return on average investment including dividends, over periods from today through max. It includes various charts and a static analysis that flags potential risks in a portfolio. You can import and export transactions, and a public API supports importing activities, exporting data and reading a public portfolio summary. The backend is NestJS with PostgreSQL, Prisma and Redis, and the frontend is Angular, shipped as Docker images for amd64 and arm platforms. An experimental Model Context Protocol server lets an AI client read the portfolio and import activities when enabled.
use_cases: track stock and ETF portfolio performance
keep a self-hosted record of investment transactions
monitor buy and hold investments across brokers
connect an AI client to a personal portfolio
how_to_run: Open the app in a browser and create a new user via Get Started (first user becomes ADMIN)
Alternatively build images: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.build.yml build && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.build.yml up -d
notable: Official Docker Hub images for linux/amd64, linux/arm/v7 and linux/arm64
Optional OpenID Connect (OIDC) login and security-token authentication
Experimental MCP server with access levels from restricted view to manage
Public API with bearer-token auth, plus Kubernetes-style health and liveness endpoints
Progressive Web App with mobile-first design, dark mode and zen mode
caveats: Several features are marked experimental, including OIDC, MCP, security headers, and the public API endpoints
Some market data sources need API keys (e.g. CoinGecko), and the Ghostfolio Premium cloud offering is a paid option
Premium-only import source GHOSTFOLIO is noted as available with Ghostfolio Premium
